_readme: Verified women's college soccer programs. Edit this file to add or update a college, then run: php artisan db:seed --class=CollegeSeeder. Use null for anything not verified from an official source. Costs are published prices before financial aid. Private colleges list the same price for in-state and out-of-state.

colleges.name: Rutgers University-New Brunswick
colleges.programs_note: No standalone education bachelor's degree reported; teacher preparation is a five-year B.A./Ed.M. program through the Graduate School of Education.
colleges.cost_note: Published total covers tuition, fees, on-campus housing and food only (no books, travel or personal costs).

colleges.name: Pennsylvania State University-Main Campus
colleges.cost_note: Verified tuition only: $10,439 per semester for Pennsylvania residents and $22,287 per semester for non-residents (full-time, lower division). Fees, housing and food for 2026-27 are unknown.
colleges.merit_aid_note: The Provost Award also considers financial need.
colleges.research_notes: The 2026-27 cost-of-attendance pages could not be read. Confirm fees, housing and food on tuition.psu.edu.

sources.note: Board of Trustees tuition announcement (tuition only)

colleges.name: Georgetown University
colleges.merit_aid_note: Aid is need-based; athletic scholarships are handled separately.

colleges.name: University of Colorado Boulder
colleges.cost_note: Base-rate majors for incoming students. Published total covers tuition, fees, on-campus housing, meals and books only.

colleges.name: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
colleges.programs_note: Psychology B.A. and B.S. confirmed in the UNC catalog.
colleges.merit_aid_note: Roughly 7% of incoming students receive a scholarship not based on need.

colleges.name: Nova Southeastern University
colleges.cost_note: NSU publishes each cost item but no total; this total adds the published on-campus items for traditional programs, including $2,674 health insurance.

colleges.name: Rollins College
colleges.cost_note: Published direct cost: $65,410 tuition plus $18,160 housing and food. Fees, books and personal costs are not listed.
colleges.research_notes: Mandatory fees for 2026-27 are unknown, so tuition and fees is left blank.

colleges.name: Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University-Daytona Beach
colleges.programs_note: No general biology major; the closest program is Aerospace Physiology. Psychology is offered as Applied Psychology.
colleges.cost_note: Student living on campus. Flight training is billed separately.

colleges.name: Bentley University
colleges.programs_note: Psychology B.S. confirmed in the Bentley catalog.

colleges.name: California State Polytechnic University-Pomona
colleges.cost_note: Student living on campus. Out-of-state figures assume 30 units per year.
colleges.merit_aid_note: Scholarships are awarded through a university application, not automatically.

colleges.name: Western Washington University
colleges.research_notes: Costs not confirmed: the site's security certificate blocked direct reading. Search excerpts showed a Washington-resident total of $33,111 (financial aid page) or $33,483 (admissions page) and a non-resident total of $46,635. Confirm on financialaid.wwu.edu/coa before adding.

colleges.name: Muhlenberg College
colleges.programs_note: No education bachelor's degrees were reported for 2024-25; the college may offer teacher certification alongside another major.
colleges.cost_note: First-year student; fees include a one-time orientation fee.

colleges.name: Susquehanna University
colleges.research_notes: Costs not confirmed: the cost page blocked direct reading. A search excerpt showed $63,500 tuition, a $1,100 comprehensive fee and $82,300 total direct charges. Confirm on susqu.edu before adding.

colleges.name: Skidmore College
colleges.cost_note: Adds the published tuition and required fees, traditional residence hall and food. Books, travel and personal costs are not included.
colleges.merit_aid_note: A few program-specific merit awards; most aid is need-based.

colleges.name: University of Scranton
colleges.cost_note: Published total direct cost: tuition, fees, housing and food. Books, travel and personal costs are not included.

colleges.name: The Catholic University of America
colleges.research_notes: Costs not confirmed: the cost pages blocked direct reading. A search excerpt showed $60,500 tuition and an $89,488 cost of attendance. Confirm on financial-aid.catholic.edu before adding.

colleges.name: Emory University
colleges.cost_note: Does not include student health insurance (about $5,592 a year unless waived).

colleges.name: University of Chicago
colleges.programs_note: No business bachelor's degrees reported in 2024-25 federal data.
colleges.research_notes: Costs not confirmed: the cost page needs JavaScript and could not be read directly. A search excerpt showed $75,960 tuition and a $103,821 on-campus cost of attendance. Confirm on financialaid.uchicago.edu before adding.

colleges.name: Washington University in St Louis
colleges.cost_note: WashU publishes $96,994 in university charges and $5,266 in other estimated expenses but no grand total; this total adds the two.
colleges.merit_aid_note: Signature scholar programs require a separate application.
